سَدِيمٌ : see سَدِمٌ, in the latter half of the para-
graph. ＝
-A2- Also Mist; syn. ضَبَابٌ: or such as is thin. (M, K.) ＝
-A3- And i. q. كَثِيرُ الذِّكْرِ (K) [app. as meaning Remembering God, or celebrating Him, much, or frequently: for SM adds], hence the saying, “لَا يَذْكُرُونَ ٱللّٰهَ إِلَّا سَدْمَا
” [app. They remember not, or celebrate not, God, otherwise than doing so much, or frequently: from which it seems that one says, ٱللّٰهَ ↓ سَدَمَ , inf. n. سَدْمٌ, meaning He remembered, or celebrated, God, &c.]. (TA.) ＝
-A4- And i. q. تَعَبٌ [Fatigue: but I incline to think that this explanation is a mistranscription]. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
